version.changelog: Image analysis skill using multimodal vision models

llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward image-analysis helper with no hidden code or persistence, though users should be careful with sensitive images.

dimensions.detail: Reading image files is proportionate for the stated purpose, but OCR examples may involve receipts, business cards, forms, screenshots, or other images containing personal or business-sensitive data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single SKILL.md artifact with empty declared requirements and no install scripts, bundled executables, dependency downloads, or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The invocation description is fairly broad and includes OCR/data extraction examples, but it remains bounded to user-provided image analysis and does not include prompt hijacking, role changes, or unrelated instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, credential access, memory writes, tool wrapping, or system modifications are present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is image description, OCR, comparison, visual Q&A, and structured extraction, and the artifact only documents use of built-in vision functions for those tasks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should treat this as a normal vision-analysis skill. Use it only on images you intend the agent to inspect, and be cautious with receipts, business cards, forms, screenshots, IDs, medical records, credentials, or confidential business documents; redact or limit extraction when full details are not needed.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The description is broad within the image-analysis domain, but the artifact ties use to image description, OCR, comparison, and visual questions; this supports guidance rather than Review escalation.
[SQP-2] expected: OCR and structured extraction from receipts, business cards, and forms are purpose-aligned, but the skill would benefit from explicit privacy guidance for sensitive documents.
